name: @nmarcofernandess/ci-queue
description: Independent local CI queue, executor and observability service

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test && npm run check:ui && npm run test:browser
scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:ui && npm run test:backend && npm run test:examples && npm run test:release && npm run test:install
scripts.release:bundle: npm run build && npm --prefix ui run build && node scripts/release.mjs build --output releases
scripts.check:ui: npm --prefix ui run lint && npm --prefix ui run build
